correctness.rationale: For simple C_3 □ C_n, n>=3, four distinct neighbors exclude the vertex itself. With pair states (a,b), 0/1 transfer edges (a,b)->(b,c) encode each vertex having at least two same-colour neighbors; closed length-n paths count labelled synchronous MM fixed points exactly once. Independent 64-state integer characteristic polynomial agrees with the stated 8-factor decomposition; the sole eigenvalue of modulus 3 is 3 by direct coefficient bounds/Rouche on each remaining factor, proving A_n~3^n. In RMM a minority vertex in any mixed three-vertex column has two disagreeing vertical neighbors, making strict 3-of-4 agreement impossible, so absorbing columns are monochromatic; the no-isolated-letter cyclic-word transfer has spectrum roots of z²-z±1, yielding B_n=phi^n+phihat^n+2cos(n pi/3)~phi^n. Exact independent direct enumeration n=3,4,5 confirms A_n=32,94,218 and B_n=2,6,12. This does not classify non-singleton recurrent classes.
